purpose: VC-9: full suite of 5560e95 re-run under a network guard that covers every Python process of the test venv, including test subprocesses
environment: development-venv of the clean reproduction (editable install of the clean clone), guard installed as site-packages/zz_netguard.pth + netguard_site.py
command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u OPENAI_API_KEY PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 NETGUARD_LOG=<log> development-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider (cwd: clean checkout)
guard: socket.connect/connect_ex and socket.getaddrinfo refuse and log every non-loopback, non-Unix target; self-test refused api.anthropic.com DNS and 1.1.1.1:443
